event_data.context: Bootstrap PR #1 review of cb7e845 reproduced this after all three launchers were installed with Lefthook 2.2.2. Remove .lefthookrc and rerun setup. Setup exits 0. A pre-push invocation naming upstream then dispatches the fast check against origin. Initial installation already requires the forwarder. Verify in a disposable real Git checkout that setup reports the missing file, the installed hook reports the missing argument without defaulting to origin, and restoring the forwarder allows a named remote push to reach its own main.
event_data.summary: Detect a missing .lefthookrc on setup reruns and prevent installed hooks from silently choosing the wrong Git remote.
event_data.title: Fail clearly when the installed Git hook argument forwarder is missing
